subject: prd/parallel-memory
statement: Bound Git process growth by reading all partition members in one batch after one tree listing; retain timing as advisory evidence.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The approved partition design trades one migration's file count for independent later edits. Exact operation counts establish the intended read strategy without a host-speed-dependent correctness threshold.
fit_criterion: The 700-member Git fixture must use two Git processes for policy discovery and reading; malformed or unavailable members still fail, and fixed inputs yield deterministic results.
